This neuron is essentially an ALL-CAPS detector with inverted sign: it goes strongly negative on tokens inside runs of fully-uppercase words (including their sub-word pieces like ARE/AS, ANN/ING, ONE), while ordinary mixed-case prose tokens give only mild positive values.
